findings.evidence: The source computes h1.close via resample('1h').last(), labels the hourly aggregate at the start of the hour, computes H1 EMA8/EMA21 on that series, then merge_asof(... direction='backward') into M5 timestamps without delaying availability until the H1 bar is closed.
findings.impact: For M5 bars inside an hour, the H1 regime may contain information from later M5 closes in the same hour. Public implementation is not admissible as causal QROS execution semantics.
findings.mandatory_correction: Construct H1 bars causally and expose EMA state to M5 only after the contributing H1 bar has fully closed. Equivalent implementation: shift the completed-H1 regime by one H1 bucket before as-of alignment, with explicit timestamp convention tested independently.

findings.evidence: sig_mtf_ema uses current M5 close, current EMA and previous close/EMA to emit the signal.
findings.impact: Entry at that same close would be non-executable under QROS causal execution rules.
findings.mandatory_correction: Signal becomes known only after the M5 bar closes; entry must occur at the first executable Bid/Ask quote after signal close.

findings.evidence: prev_c=np.roll(c,1) and prev_f=np.roll(fast,1) wrap the final sample into index 0.
findings.impact: The first observation is contaminated by future/end-of-series data.
findings.mandatory_correction: Explicitly invalidate the first row for every lagged feature; no wraparound is allowed.

findings.evidence: The public simulator enters at signal-bar close, uses OHLC highs/lows for exits, does not use Bid/Ask, and fills SL/TP at synthetic barrier prices.
findings.impact: Public PnL cannot be imported into QROS. Only the signal thesis and parameter genealogy are admissible.
findings.mandatory_correction: Reimplement on QROS Bid/Ask data with BUY Ask entry/Bid exit, SELL Bid entry/Ask exit, SL-first ambiguity, first available price on gaps, no artificial zero-spread fills, and same-day exit.

causal_seed_after_correction.higher_timeframe_regime: EMA_FAST_HTF > EMA_SLOW_HTF for BUY; inverse for SELL, using last fully closed HTF bar only
causal_seed_after_correction.lower_timeframe_event: temporary pullback toward/through a fast LTF EMA followed by causal recovery/continuation confirmation
causal_seed_after_correction.entry: first executable quote after the confirming LTF bar closes
